records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Studio
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Ridge Studio* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive early signals: first project reached day 1 (facts) and one invite sent, noted internally [slack:dca0d7bb]. Customer replies are brief and non-committal [email:41ebe43a], with no questions or blockers and no tickets; key milestone still unreached after 6 days with 8 left on a Starter plan, so momentum is uncertain.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the note 
dd glad the handoff's going smoothly, and good to see your project and teammate invite in place.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the usual next step is getting a few real tasks into that first project so your teammate has something to pick up. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a 15-minute call this week and walk through it with you 
dd just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
